result.title: Appearance Compensation in Volume Rendering
result.summary: Can a volume that reproduces every external RGB view still have an incorrect density? We study this question in emission-absorption rendering with an independently parameterized, physically bounded effective source. Appearance compensates a density change by replacing the radiance that it removes from the rest of each ray. We characterize the surviving density information with a shared spatial appearance field. Our first result is an optimal density-only gain after finite-degree spherical-harmonic source refitting. A coupled tensor gauge and physical localized packets identify the sharp limiting nonlinear inverse coefficient as its reciprocal. Our second result realizes positive gain at every fixed finite degree for a residual set of isotropic spatial sources at one fixed density. At the same references, growing angular capacity hides a fixed nonzero density error while retaining physicality and any prescribed finite set of smoothness bounds. Local identifiability and the absence of a capacity-uniform recovery modulus therefore coexist. Our third result constructs an exact physical SH2 ambiguity: central density doubles and relative density $L^2$ error exceeds $14.52\%$, yet every external RGB ray is unchanged. We connect these continuum results to shared finite representations, continuous pixel measurements and density-sensitive acquisition. Complete-class certificates separate SH0, SH1 and SH2 fits at one learned density. Finite-camera results expose the distinct role of spatial capacity, and transmission measurements separate otherwise identical RGB fields. Controlled training tests and captured-smoke profiles supply mechanism evidence with explicit observation scopes. The results show why rendering accuracy alone cannot certify density: recovery also depends on appearance capacity, spatial resolution and measurement design.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究体渲染中外观补偿问题：独立参数化的有效光源能否掩盖密度错误，证明存在外部 RGB 视角完全不变而密度翻倍、相对 L² 误差超 14.5% 的 SH2 物理歧义，并刻画角容量、空间分辨率与传输测量对密度可辨识性的作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观测完全等价却内部状态错误」的不可辨识性结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要视觉信息、信息坍缩与视觉旁路的评价设计提供概念类比，可供核查。
